title: dupatya polyantha
intro: Dupatya polyantha, commonly known as Java tea, is a plant species native to Indonesia, which belongs to the family Rutaceae and is used as a medicinal plant. The leaves of Dupatya polyantha have been used in traditional medicine for their health benefits, including reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and aiding in the treatment of various digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dupatya polyantha include its antihistamine, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in relieving symptoms of allergies, skin infections, and inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Dupatya polyantha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
